subject.title: [Feature]: Support configurable request labels for Gemini API calls (GCP billing tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a Google Vertex request-label config contract, and which static or dynamic labels plus validation limits are acceptable?
rationale: This adds public provider config surface and can propagate operator/user metadata into Google billing systems, so automation should not choose the product and privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve Static Vertex Labels
options.body: Add a Vertex-only static label map with strict Google label validation, docs, and transport tests; leave dynamic labels for a later explicit decision.

options.title: Approve A Broader Metadata Contract
options.body: Design a cross-provider request-metadata abstraction only if maintainers want one source of truth for Google labels, Anthropic metadata, and future provider tags.

options.title: Defer Labels
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not implement until privacy, cardinality, and billing-reporting requirements are clearer.

recommendation.title: Approve Static Vertex Labels
recommendation.body: Add a Vertex-only static label map with strict Google label validation, docs, and transport tests; leave dynamic labels for a later explicit decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged production Vertex ADC work is the closest current-main history for the provider path this config would extend.
